Solutions-oriented and creative problem solver. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to interact professionally with clients and colleagues. Commitment to continuous improvement and adaptability in changing environments. Skills SPECIFIC TECHNICAL SKILLS Cvent, Map Your Show or other event technologies, a plus Other Requirements Travel: Approximately 20%, chiefly 4-5 day blocks of time Benefits Summary MCI USA is an established, family-friendly company offering outstanding benefits and significant growth opportunities. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment with equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, age or physical/mental ability. We appreciate all who apply, though only those selected for an interview will be contacted. All applications remain confidential. MCI USA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. paragraphs: I am excited to apply for the Events Coordinator position at MCI USA. With a strong background in coordinating diverse community and corporate events, I believe my skills align perfectly with your requirements.

My experience includes successfully planning and executing 14 community events (averaging 25 international participants each), managing logistics, stakeholder liaison, and ensuring smooth operations. Additionally, I have demonstrated exceptional project management skills by drafting, reviewing, and negotiating 5-7 commercial agreements per month for corporate clients at Poise Legal.

I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), which reflects my commitment to integrating my international legal expertise with the Finnish system. My fluency in both English and Finnish, along with my native Malayalam language skills, allows me to communicate effectively across diverse cultural backgrounds.

MCI USA's reputation for creating human-centric touchpoints resonates strongly with my values and aspirations. I am eager to contribute my event coordination experience and multicultural communication abilities to your team, helping brands, associations, and not-for-profit organizations solve their key people challenges through our core expertise in live and virtual events.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to MCI USA's success.
